column3: “the journeys” renders “the settings out,” “by their armies” renders “by their hosts,” and “under the leadership of” renders “by the hand of.”
“their starting places” renders “their goings out,” and “by the command of the LORD” renders “at the mouth of the LORD” (also in verse 38).
“started out boldly” renders “went out with a raised hand,” and “the Egyptians” renders “Egypt” (also in verse 4).
NASB renders “set out” as “journeyed” throughout the list (verses 5–49).
“turned back” renders the singular “he turned back,” and “faces” renders “is on the face of.”
“the Red Sea” renders “Sea of Reeds” (also in verse 11).
“now it was there that the people had no water” renders “and there was no water there for the people.”
